scope: Fold 0, same 10 training and 52 validation cases; 24 checkpoint files, 48 split profiles. No spatial predictions, training, or inference.

definitions.confusion: Rows are ground truth; columns are predictions; 0=background, 1=anterior, 2=posterior.
definitions.oracle: Correct A/P swaps only, leave all foreground/background mistakes unchanged; reconstruct per-case class-mean Dice and average over cases.
